description: Allowlist of admitted external-import nodes. Each entry is a named, precisely-cited, scope-limited standard textbook theorem that makes NO framework-specific claim. An authority on this allowlist is accepted as retained-grade upstream FOR ITS STATED SCOPE ONLY (see AUDIT_AGENT_PROMPT_TEMPLATE.md), so a dependent note may cite it without an automatic not-retained-grade downgrade. This does not change the import note's own audited status; it only lets vetted textbook results serve as cited upstream, the way a math paper cites a textbook theorem. PR adds the carve-out + the first two entries.

uhf_tracial_uniqueness_textbook_import_n.imported_result: The UHF C*-algebra of type 2^infinity has a unique tracial state (Powers 1967); its finite-region restriction is the normalized trace.
uhf_tracial_uniqueness_textbook_import_n.citation: Powers 1967; Bratteli-Robinson, Operator Algebras and Quantum Statistical Mechanics; standard UHF/AF C*-algebra theory.

naimark_dilation_textbook_import_note_20.imported_result: Naimark dilation: every POVM dilates to a PVM on a larger space; for a projective measurement the canonical dilation gives Kraus operators K_r = P_r.
naimark_dilation_textbook_import_note_20.citation: Naimark 1940; Holevo, Probabilistic and Statistical Aspects of Quantum Theory, Ch. III; Watrous, Theory of Quantum Information, Sec. 2.4.
